note: Set A correctly extracts the Lynx focal length (10 m) as a specific attribute, whereas Set B mislabels this value as 'size' and truncates the supporting quote. Both sets suffer from similar OCR artifacts creating invalid entities (e.g., 'n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope') and vague generic entities (e.g., 'spacecraft'), but Set A provides more accurate engineering parameter binding for the Lynx mission.
